title: DW3 port tables/<table>.json (a table patch, <table>-v1)
description: A patch of a data table of the game (pc/shim/table_mods.c). The field names and ranges of each table are in the reference file the port writes in <pref>/data/tables/<table>.json (its "notes"); this schema checks the shape every table shares.

format.description: <table>-v1, the name of the file without .json.

rows.description: The row key (see the table's reference file) -> fields. "*" is every row; a row with its own key wins on the fields it names.

additionalProperties.description: Field name -> a number (replaces), an operation "*k" "+k" "-k" on the current value, or for a list field a list of ids/names or {"add": [...], "remove": [...]}.

oneOf.description: A name a content mod defines (<mod>:<name>).
